# Class: `DropletDetectionTools`

Owns the detection action, model configuration, worker, and result insertion.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-droplet-tools.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_droplet_tools.py#L84) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QObject`.

Uses selected circles as guidance and existing circles as protected regions. Snapshot validation rejects results after relevant session changes. Accepted circles must fit the image and crop and are added together through the main window's cell history.
